description: Historical completed low-step evaluations; no generation performed during commit curation.
sample_accounting: 171 unique cells x 20 scored samples = 3420. Includes original 10 cells / 200 samples once; 2080 new at 16/32 transitions and 1140 new at 8 transitions. Reference gate duplicates excluded.
method: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples of 20 matching seed indices; recompute exp(sum(token_count * mean_nll) / sum(token_count)); 95% percentile intervals, RNG seed 20260917. Intervals are exploratory and not adjusted for multiple comparisons or selecting the best checkpoint. They do not measure variability across independent training runs.
timing: Generation only; excludes loading, gate duplicates and scoring. Same H200 NVL host, sequential observations.
ppl_definition: exp(sum(per_sample_mean_nll * scored_tokens) / sum(scored_tokens)); EOS policy and evaluator provenance in each row.
selection_warning: Checkpoint selection and intervals use the same 20 seeds. Exploratory, no multiple-testing adjustment, no independent training replicates.

gate.scope: One full 8-transition first sample on the same loaded model/GPU; final tokens/NFE/RNG, not every intermediate state.
